scene_description: A young child wearing a red outfit and a Santa hat sits on the floor in front of a lit Christmas tree and a fireplace. The child is opening a glowing gift box.

questions.question: Who is sitting on the floor?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person in the middle of the picture.

questions.question: What is on the child's head?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of the child's head.

questions.question: What is the child opening?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is in front of the child on the floor.

questions.question: Where is the Christmas tree?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big decorated tree in the background.

questions.question: What is glowing in the fireplace?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the right side of the picture near the wall.
